info.name: individuals-api
info.description:
Every endpoint of individuals-api for two users, Ivan and Anna, so each one can be checked on its own afterwards: in Keycloak (admin console, realm payment-platform, Users) and through /me with that user's token.

Nothing is copied by hand: every request stores what the next one needs in collection variables. Run the whole collection with Postman's Runner, top to bottom.

Run it on a fresh stack (make up after the volumes were removed). The emails are fixed so the users are easy to find; a second run on the same stack answers 409 on registration, which is correct.

Registration goes through the real person-service: it stores Ivan and Anna with their address and personal data, gives each a userUid, and answers 409 to a second registration of the same email.

variable.description: Only to check that user_uid is the id of the individual person-service stored.
The same for both users, to keep the collection short.
Wallet types are seeded in transaction-service (V003__seed_wallet_types.sql); no endpoint lists them.
